definition: The Brief Visuospatial Memory Test is a cognitive assessment used to evaluate visuospatial memory. In this source, it is listed as one of the tests used to measure cognitive outcomes in people with multiple sclerosis.

reasons: The packet supports that Brief Visuospatial Memory Test (BVMT) was listed among cognitive tests used in studies of people with multiple sclerosis, but it does not state that the test evaluates visuospatial memory.
